## Statement of the First Law

Placeholder text. Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only converted between forms.

## Internal Energy

Placeholder text. Internal energy $U$ represents the total microscopic energy of a system.

## Enthalpy

Placeholder text. Enthalpy $H = U + PV$ is a convenient state function for open systems and constant-pressure processes.

## Energy Balance for a Closed System

Placeholder text. For a closed system:

$$\Delta U = Q - W$$

where $Q$ is heat added to the system and $W$ is work done by the system.
